h1: Influencer outreach to creators who fit your products
overview: We find creators whose audience matches your buyers and write the first message to them. We check each profile for a real, engaged audience, a fitting style and past brand work, then build a list with contact routes and notes. We send personal outreach from your own account or email, and track the replies. Agreements and payments stay between you and the creator, and sponsored posts follow disclosure rules.

faq: Can you promise creators will say yes?
No. Replies depend on your product, budget and the creator's schedule. We improve your odds with personal messages and a clear offer, and we report honestly on who answered.
You do, directly, under terms you agree. We do not hold money or take a share. Our price covers the research, writing and sending only.
Do you buy followers or fake engagement?
No, and we also avoid creators with signs of fake followers. We use public information only, and we follow each platform's rules and advertising disclosure laws for sponsored posts.
Can you contact people on my behalf?
Yes, from your own email or social account, which you share with us through a limited invite. Messages are short, personal and never bulk spam, and we stop if someone says no.
